title: Agent Credential Schemes
summary: Invitation is not credential. Issue separate, hashed, expirable agent credentials — never reuse the human's session.

title: No Simulated Execution
summary: Never claim a write succeeded without a verified receipt. Queued is not changed; staged is not published.

title: Scoped AI Access Grants
summary: Human-created, scoped, revocable authorization objects for agents — a narrowed lane instead of impersonating the user.

title: Stage and Approve
summary: The assist-only pattern — the agent stages a draft as a pending record; nothing goes live until the human clicks approve.

title: The Assist-Only MCP Bridge
summary: Expose scoped staging tools over MCP so agents draft into a review queue — they can prepare anything, publish nothing.

title: The Machine-Readable Primer
summary: A schema-versioned JSON document that tells an AI agent exactly what it may do, what it must never claim, and where human authority begins.

title: Well-Known Discovery
summary: Advertise agent endpoints from /.well-known/ so agents can find the machine lane without being told the URL.
